dngos gnyen la dgongs so/ /mdzod 'grel las kyang*/ 'phags pa'i lam thams cad kyang gdul bya'i rgyud la 'jug pa'i phyir chos kyi 'khor lo yin te/ zhes so/ /chos kyi 'khor lo cig car du bskor ram/ rim can du bskor/ zhe na/ kha cig na re/ chos 'khor ma lus pa skad cig kho na la bskor yang gdul bya'i dbang gis dus snga phyi dang tha dad du mos pa tsam du zad do/ /zhes zer ro/ /de lta na ston pas chos kyi 'khor lo gsum po bskor ba'i gnas dang*/ dus dang*/ 'khor dang*| dgos pa rnams tha dad du gsungs pa mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ ston pas chos kyi 'khor lo gsum po de dus cig car du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'khor lo gsum po de gdul bya'i dbang gis rim can du gsungs pa yin te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ dpyod pa ba dag ji lta bu/ /yi ge'i phyi mo klog 'jug ltar| |de bzhin sangs rgyas gdul bya la/ /ji tsam bzod pa'i chos ston to/ kha cig la ni sdig pa las/ /rnam par bzlog phyir chos ston to/ kha cig bsod nams sgrub pa'i phyir/ kha cig las ni gnyis brten pa/ kha cig las ni gnyis mi brten/ /zab mo khu 'phrig can 'jigs pa/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// byang chub sgrub pa kha cig la'o/ /zhes so/ /de'iphyir chos kyi 'khor lo rin can du bskor ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ theg pa thun mong ba ltar na/ tsheg bar sum cu so gnyis la sho lo ka gcig tu byas pa'i sho lo ka gcig tu byas pa'i sho lo stong ni chos kyi phung po cig gi tshad yin te/ chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis/ de la chos kyi phung po gcig gi tshad gang zhe na/ tshig le'ur byas pa stong nyid de/ tshigs （19na）su bcad pa re re la yi ge'i 'bru sum cu so gnyis so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /theg chen pa ltar na/ glang po che rab brtan gyis 'khur bar 'os pa'i snag tshas ni/ chos kyi phung po gcig 'bri bar nus so/ /zhes dang*/

drin lan bsab pa las/ 'phags pa lha sbyin gyis glang po che lnga stong gis 'khur bar bya ba'i glegs bam rnams kha ton du brjod par byed do/ /zhes dang*/ nor bzang gi bla ma dge slong sprin gyi dpal zhes bya ba rgya mtsho zhig gi mtha' rtogs pa la phyin pa na/ mtsho de'i dkyil nas pad ma chen po zhig byung*/ de la sangs rgyas phyag brkyang ba zhes bya ba zhig bzhugs nas kun tu mig gi chos kyi rnam grangs gsungs te/ de'i le'u lag re bri ba la yang rgya mtsho de'i chu la snag tsha byas/ rtsi shing nags tshal la smyu gu byas/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnams kyis yig mkhan byed dgos par gsungs so/ /yang kha cig na re/ sha ri'i bus byas pa'i chos kyi phung po zhes pa'i bstan bcos kyi tshad tsam ste/ de yang sho lo ka drug stong zhes 'dod pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig na re/ phung khams skye mched/ bden pa rten 'brel sogs la brtsams nas/ don tshan re rdzogs par ston pa'i gtam gyi tshogs la 'dod do| |gzhan dag na re 'dod chags sogs la spyod pa re re'i gnyen po rdzogs par ston pa'i gtam gyi rgyud la bzhed la/ de yang gdul bya'i dbang gis tshad nges pa ni med do/ /de ltar yang mdzod las/ kha cig bstan bcos tshad ces zer| |phung po la sogs gtam re yin/ /spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ / chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyag 'tshal lo zhes drang ngo*/ /gang la na/ yum de la'o/ /ci'i phyir yum zhes bya zhe na/ sangs rgyas nyan thos la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba dag gi bzhed don de sgrub par byed pa nyid kyis so/ /bzhi pa ni/ ci'i phyir yum la phyag 'tshal zhe na/ bstan bcos rtsom zhes shugs la bstan to/ /dgos pa med do zhe na/ yod par dgos 'brel gyis ston no/ /dgos pa de ldan gyi bstan bcos gang zhe na/ bstan bcos kyi lus dang*/ yan lag gis ston no/ /gal te dang por gzhi shes la bstod par mi rigs te/

rgyas bshad kyis go rim dang mi mthun pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ 'di la kha cig mdo'i gleng gzhi'i go rim dang mthun pa'i phyir dang mchod brjod kyang gleng gzhi'i don sdud byed yin te/ rin chen sgron ma las/ gleng gzhi rgyas par bka' bstsal don mchog rnams/ /legs par bsdus pa phyag 'tshal tshigs bcad yin/ /zhes bshad pas so zhes zer ro/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ mchod brjod dang gleng gzhi/ slob dpon dang 'phags pa sogs kyis kyang ma sbyar ba'i phyir dang*/ rin chen sgron ma bod kyis （19ba）byas pa'i phyir shes byed du mi che'o/ /des na sher phyin gyi gdul bya lam gsum la rim gyis 'god pa'i dbang du byas nas bstan ta ོ / /lnga pa la/ rgol ba dang*/ lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ sher phyin la phyag 'tshal bas/ mkhyen gsum brjod byar byed pa'i bstan bcos rtsom/ / zhes shugs la dam bcas pa ni/ gang la rgol ba'i yul lo/ /rtsod pa'i tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ tshul de ltar yum la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mkhyen gsum la bstod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas mkhyen gsum ston pa'i bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsom na/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab bskyed pa'i ched du/ gzhi phung khams skye mched kyi mtshan nyid rab dbye tsam dang*/ mi mthun phyogs spang ba'i ched du gnyen po lam tsam dang*/ shes bya thams cad shes par bya ba'i ched du rdzas btags la sogs pa rnam pa'i rab dbye rnams las/ gang yang rung ba zhig brjod byar bsdus par mdzad ces brtag grang na/ phyogs dang po ltar na rgyan rtsom pa la 'bad pa don med pa yin te/ chos mngon pa dang zlos par 'gyur pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'di las ni/ mtshan nyid kyi bstan bcos mngon pa'i sde snod dag las mi smos pa'i gzhi gang yin pa de 'byung ba ni med pas so/

/gnyis pa ltar na yang spang bya kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dngos po brjod byar ma bsdus par 'gyur te/ gnyen po rnam par byang ba'i dngos po tsam zhig brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na lam gsum po 'di spang bya gang gi gnyen po yin par khong du chud par mi 'gyur te/ nad ngos ma zin pa'i sman bzhin no/ / gsum pa ltar na yang 'grel chen nas bshad pa ltar rnam pa gzhi bcas sam| gzhi med ston/ dang po ltar na/ gzhi la bkod pa'i nyes pa mtshungs so// gnyis pa ltar na/ gzhi'i don rtogs pa med par thal/ rnam pa gzhi med pa tsam zhig brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ skyes bu la nye bar mkho ba'i don cung zad kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir/ bstan bcos rtsom pa la/ don nam dgos pa med pa yin no/ /snyam du gzhan dag sems par gyur pa ma yin nam zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum/ rtags dgod/ sgrub byed bstan/ mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ ji skad brjod pa'i skyon de ni yod pa ma yin te/ gang gi phyir zhe na/ yul can mkhyen gsum shes pa'i don du gzhi gnyen rnam pa'i phyogs gsum char brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ yul phyogs gsum char brjod byar bsdus shing*/ gsum char gyis kyang yul can mkhyen gsum bsdus la/ yul can thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis go rim （20na）bzhin du nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag gzhi shes kyis bsdus la/ byang chub sems dpa' dang bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag lam shes dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyis bsdus pas na'o/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ shes byed kyi lung dgod pa dang*/ lung gi don bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ yum bar ma dang*/ bsdus pa dang*/ rgyas pa'i lung khungs dgod pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus pa'i tshul ni/

'di ltar rgyal ba'i yum bar ma las/ rab 'byor thams cad shes pa nyid kyis ni/ nyan thos da rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa bsdus pa yin no/ /lam shes pa nyid kyis ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mngon bar rtogs pa bsdus pa yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa bsdus pa yin no/ / zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ gsum las/ dang po gzhi shes la/ rgyu mtshan 'dri ba dang*| rgyu mtshan dgod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du thams cad 'tshal ba nyid kyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs bsdus pa lags zhes zhus pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rab 'byor nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni thams cad shes pa nyid kyis bsdus zhes bya'o/ /rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir zhe na/ thams cad ni phyi dang nang gi phung khams skye mched kyi chos rnams ji snyed pa 'di tsam yin la/ de dag kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdag med pa tsam du shes kyi theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad kyis kyang nges par 'byung ba ma yin pas lam shes med la rgyu 'bras ngo bo'i rnam pa thams cad du shes pa yang ma yin pas rnam mkhyen yang ma yin pa de'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa lam shes la sngar bzhin gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du/ lam gyi rnam pa 'tshol ba nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa bsdus pa lags zhes pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni lam shes pa nyid kyis bsdus zhes bya'o/ /rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir zhe na/ thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas bsdus pa de'i phyir ro/ /de la shes rab ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ nyan thos kyi lam gang yin pa gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rigs dang*/（20ba）rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rigs dang*/

sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa'i chos kyi bdag med rgyas par rtogs pa'i lam thams cad bskyed par bya zhing lam gsum po thams cad shes par bya'o/ /lam gsum po de dag kyang spangs rtogs kyi sgo nas yongs su rdzogs par bya zhing*/ byang sems de dag gi lam gyi bya ba sgrib pa spong ba dang*/ sems can smin pa sogs kyi bya ba yang bya'o/ /thabs ni/ byang sems de dag gis rang don du goms pa lhur len gyi tshul gyis yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du mi bya'o/ /dus thams cad du mi bya'am zhe na/ ji srid smon lam yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa dang*| sems can rnams yongs su smin par ma byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su ma sbyangs bar du'o/ / 'dir nyan rang gi spangs rtogs gang du rdzogs/ rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi tshad/ yang dag mtha' mngon du byas pa'i don rnams ji lta bu zhe na/ nyan rang dgra bcom pas ci tsam zhig rtogs pa dang*/ ji tsam zhig spangs pa/ theg chen gyi lam gang nas rtogs pa dang spangs pa yin/ zhes ngos 'dzin pa yin la| de yang rtogs pa'i rigs sa dang por rdzogs te/ sa dang por gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa las bogs dbyung du med pa'i phyir ro/ / 'khor bar 'ching byed kyi nyon mongs tsam spangs pas dang por rdzogs te/ sa dang por 'khor bar 'ching byed kyi nyon mongs ma lus par spangs pa'i phyir ro/ / de ltar yang nyi snang las rgyun du zhugs pa nas/ rang sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi shes pa dang*/ spong ba gang yin ba de ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ bzod pa gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa yang rang nyid gang du sangs rgyas pa'i zhing 'og min lta bu'i dbang du byas nas rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum byas pa'i tshad 'dzin pa yin zhing*/ de la sems can smin pa'i tshad ni|

rang nyid sangs rgyas pa'i zhing de'i dngos kyi gdul bya yin na/ gnyen po rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pas khyab pa yin te/ de yin na 'phags pa yin pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /smon lam rdzogs pa'i tshad ni/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar rtog pa med kyang chos sku las ma g.yos bzhin du sems can gyi don byed par gyur cig ces pa'i smon lam mthar thug pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pa'i tshad ni/ rang nyid sangs rgyas pa'i zhing ni 'og min chen po lta bu yin la/ sbyangs pa ni rang gi sems sbyangs pa'o/ /de yang zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba （21na）sgom pa lta bu'o/ /sbyangs pa'i tshad mthar thug pa ni/ rang nyid sangs rgyas pa'i zhing gcong rong dang ngam grog la sogs med par mnyam pa dang*/ mnan na nem byed pa dang*/ bteg na 'phar byed pa dang*/ gser gyi gzhi la baiḍūr+ya'i mig mangs ris su bris pa la sogs pa dag pa 'ba' zhig tu snang ba'o/ /gsum pa yang*/ de bzhin nyid goms kyang de mngon du mi byed/ ces gsungs pas/ chos nyid la mnyam par 'jog par goms kyang gtso bor chos nyid la mnyam par 'jog par mi byed ces pa'i don yin la/ 'dir yang gtso bor chos nyid la mnyam par bzhag par mi bya'o/ /dus nam gyi tshe mi bya na/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas par mi bya'o/ /byas na skyon ci yod ce na/ gzhan don mi 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na sangs rgyas la yang mtshungs so zhe na/ mi mtshungs te/ mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas rjes thob tu gzhan don byed par mi 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na gtan du mi bya'am zhe na/ rdzogs smin gsum byas nas gtso bor chos nyid la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /des na yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du byas pa'i tshad ni/ chos nyid la gtso bor mnyam par bzhag pa la bya'o/ /rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum dang yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du byas pa'i tshad 'dzin pa ni mthar thug gi dbang du byas pa'o//

yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed pa'i tshul de lta bu yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ byang chub sems dpas rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas par gtso bor chos nyid la mnyam par 'jog par mi byed de/ gtso bor myang 'das tsam thob pa don du mi gnyer ba'i phyir ro/ /gtso bor thabs kyi cha rnams sgrub ste/ gtso bor gzhan don don du gnyer ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang nyan thos dgra bcom theg chen lam du zhugs pa ni byang sems las dang po pa las bskal pa grangs med gcig gis 'tshang rgya ba bul bar bshad pa yang sngar thar pa thob pa'i ched du gtso bor bdag med la mnyam bar bzhag pas theg pa chen po'i lam du'ang sngon goms pa'i dbang gis yid zhi bde'i dbang du song nas dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems las gtso bor thabs kyi cha rnams sgrub pa la mi brtson pas bul ba yin no/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir yang 'di 'grub bo/ /de lta ma yin na byang sems kyis bskal ba grangs med du tshogs bsags kyang myang 'das mi thob pa dang*/ nyan thos myur ba tshe gsum nas myang 'das thob pa'i khyad par mi 'thad par thal ba dang/ nyon mongs mi spong ba'i rang bzhin bstan nas yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed pa de'i byed las su bstan pa yang 'brel med du 'gyur ro/ /

gsum pa la sngar bzhin gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu mtshan （21ba）ci'i slad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa bsdus pa lags zhes pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis bsdus zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ rnam pa ngo bo gang dag gi chos rnams rab tu brjod pa'i rnam pa de dag dang rtags 'bras bu gang dag dang*/ rgyu mtshan ma gang dag gi chos rnams rab tu brjod pa'i rtags de dag dang mtshan ma de dag de bzhin gshegs pas thugs su chud pa de'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ yum bar ma de bzhin du mdor bsdus pa brgyad stong pa las kyang gsungs so/ /ji ltar zhe na/ nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ sogs pa'i sgras rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang sangs rgyas kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang*/ zhes sbrel lo/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyas pa stong phrag brgya pa las kyang gsungs so/ /ji ltar na/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ / gnyis pa ni/ mdo las mkhyen gsum gsungs pa de la thams cad shes pa nyid ni dmigs pa gzugs la sogs pa'i chos la dmigs nas rnam pa mi rtag pa la sogs pa bcu drug gi rten can dang*/ 'bras bu gang zag gi bdag tu rmongs pa spangs pa can yin no/ /lam shes pa nyid ni dmigs pa lam gsum/ rnam pa shes rab kyis/ theg pa thams cad kyi spang bya la/ nges par 'byung ba dang*| snying rjes rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas par de kho na nyid mngon sum du mi byed pa'i rten dang*/ 'bras bu sems can 'khor du ma bsdus pa sdud pa dang sogs pas bsdus pa smin pa dang*/

smin pa grol ba dang*/ grol ba mthar phyin par byed pa can yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni dmigs pa chos thams cad rnam pa skye ba med pa'i rten can/ 'bras bu nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs par sems can gyi don 'khor ba ji srid par rgyun mi 'chad pa ste| gzhan don no/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' rtogs pa mthar thug pa dang*/ ma rig pa dang bcas pa'i bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba nyid spangs pa can yin no// snga mas rtogs pa bstan la/ phyi mas spangs pa bstan te/ rang don mthar thug pa'o| | gsum pa ni/ mkhyen gsum gyis mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus pa de lta bas na/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ni chos can/ sher phyin gyi rang bzhin mngon par rtogs pa ril rdzogs par （22na）bstan pa yin no/ /zhes bya ba 'di 'thad pa yin te/ yul gzhi lam rnam gsum gyis yul can mkhyen pa gsum bsdus la/ mkhyen gsum gyis mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus shing*/ khyod kyi yul can gsum shes pa'i ched du/ yul gzhi dang*/ gnyen po dang*/ rnam pa mtha' dag brjod byar bsdus pas so/ /rtsod pa 'di paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum pa dang*/ ar la sogs pa kha cig dgos 'brel gyi gzhung yin te/ nyi snang dang 'grel chen gnyis kar dgos 'brel gyi gzhung du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bzhed do| |'grel ba mkhan po kha cig dang*/ lo ts+tsha ba chen po na re/ mchod brjod kyi gzhung la sbyar te/ 'di brgal lan gyis gtan la dbab pa yin la/ mchod brjod kyang bshad thabs yan lag lnga'i sgo nas bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bzhed do/ /'di ni 'gal bar mi bsam ste/ 'grel pa 'dir mchod brjod la sbyar ba 'grig cing*/ de yang mchod brjod bshad thabs yan lag lngas 'chad pa dang*| gang las 'phros pa'i 'brel gyi dbang du byas nas bshad pa yin no// 'grel pa che ba gnyis su dgos med kyi log rtog gi dbang du byas nas dgos 'brel las 'phros par gsungs te/ dgos 'brel gyis dgos med kyi log rtog bkag nas bstan bcos kyi dgos pa sgrub pa'i phyir ro/

/ ga2 dgos 'brel bshad pa/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ mdo'i 'brel ni/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nur gyur pa rnams kyang 'dus par gzigs par gyur to'i bar ro/ /snga 'grel ni/ gsungs te zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ byams pa rang gi bstan bcos kyi brjod par bya ba dang*/ dgos pa dang*| dgos pa'i yang dgos pa dang*/ 'brel ba rtsa tshig gi khong na yod pa rnams so/ /dgos pa ci'i phyir gsungs she na/ rtog ldan bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag tu'o/ /dgos sogs bstan pas 'jug pa'i yan lag tu ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ 'jug pa'i gegs dgos med kyi dogs pa bsal ba'i phyir dang mthun rkyen don la dgos pa phal cher yod snyam pa'i don 'gyur gyi the tshom skyed pa nyid kyis so/ /dogs pa ji ltar 'byung zhe na/ dogs zhes drang ngo*/ /gang gis na| skye bo blo gros dman pa dag gis so/ /gang la na/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba byams pas slar yang yum gyi don de bstan pa la'o/ /ji ltar na/ don nam dgos pa ci zhig yod de/ med do snyam du'o/ / de'i rgyu mtshan bcom ldan 'das rgyas pa dang*/ 'bring dang*/ mdor bsdus pa la dad pa'i sems can la phan 'dogs par bzhed pa thugs rje can nyid kyis rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring de dang bsdus pa de las （22ba）shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i don nyams su len tshul rnams mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi rim pa mtha' dag gsal bar mdzad zin pa ma yin nam ste yin pa'i phyir ro// de la 'dir ngag tsam la yod pa'i dgos 'brel/ /dgos 'brel ngag la yod pa'i dgos 'brel/ bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos 'brel dang gsum/ dang po ni bden pa'i don can gyi tshigs thams cad la rtsir rung ste/ dper na bum pa zhes pa'i ngag lta bu ste/ bum pa ni brjod bya/ de las don rtogs pa dgos pa/ de las skyes bu'i 'dod don 'grub pa nying dgos so/

/snga ma med na phyi ma mi 'byung ba ni 'brel ba'o/ /gnyis pa la brjod bya ni/ bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos sogs chos bzhi'o/ /dgos pa ni/ dogs pa bsal ba dang*/ rtog ldan la don 'gyur gyi the tsom mam/ nges pa bskyed pa'o/ /nying dgos ni/ de la brten nas rgyan la 'jug pa'o/ /'brel ba ni/ de dag snga ma med na phyi ma mi 'byung ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa tshig gi skabs su ston no/ /rtsa ba la bstan tshul dang*/ tshig don gnyis las/ dang po ni rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis brjod bya bstan la/ gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin te/ blo dang ldan bas mthong 'gyur zhes pa'i bar gyis nying dgos bstan cing*/ phyir zhes pa nas rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin zhes pa'i bar gyis dgos pa bstan pa yin no/ /phyir zhes pa dang*/ dgos pa yin zhes dngos su bstan pa las 'brel pa shugs la rtogs te/ ji skad du/ / bstan bcos dang ni dgos pa'i don/ /'brel ba'i gzhi ni gnyis la gnas// de bstan 'dus pa de yi phyir/ /dgos las logs shig ma bstan to/ /zhes so// gnyis pa la bzhi las/ brjod bya ni ston pas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'di las bshad pa gang yin pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang*/ de thob byed kyi lam ste/ mngon par rtogs pa brgyad po mtha' dag go nying dgos ni/ mthong bar 'gyur zhes drang ngo*/ /gang na/ byang sems las/ gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen de'o/ /gang gis na/ blo dang ldan pas so/ /thabs gang las na/ mdo'i don thos pa'i shes rab kyis rtogs pa bzhin du/ shes bzhin dang ldan pa'i dran pa la bzhag nas sgom byung gi shes rab kyis mngon du byed do/ /mdo'i don gang zhe na/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ sbyin pa la sogs pa chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid do/ /shan+ti pas/ dbus mtha' las/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*// nyan dang klog dang len pa dang*/ /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*/ /de sems pa dang sgom pa ste/

/spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid ni/ /bsod nams （23na）phung po dpag tu med/ /ces gsungs pa la bzhed do/ /'ga' zhig rnam mkhyen gyi chos bcu la 'dod cing*/ kha cig dge bcu la 'dod kyang*/ gnas pa'i don ni| theg chen sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'o/ / dgos pa ni/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin no/ /gang na/ nying dgos kyi phyir du mdo don rgyan la brten nas bde blag tu tshegs chung ngus rtogs pa zhes bya ba'o| |gang gis rtogs na/ blo dang ldan pa zhes sbrel lo/ /ci'i phyir/ dgos sogs chos bzhi dgos she na/ brjod bya med na/ bstan bcos la rna gtod par mi 'gyur la/ dgos pa med na/ bstan bcos la mi 'jug cing*/ dgos pa tsam yod kyang nying dgos med na/ rtogs ldan gyis don du mi gnyer ba'i phyir ro/ / spyir brjod bya sogs yod kyang*/ bstan bcos 'di dang 'brel ba med na/ bstan bcos 'di la brten nas/ mdo'i don mi rtogs snyam pa'i dogs pa'o/ / des na/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i gegs log rtog bzhir nges pa'i phyir ro// de'i gnyen por dgos sogs chos bzhir nges so/ /gsum pa 'grel pa la bzhi las| brjod bya ni/ rgyal ba'i yum rnam pa gsum char las brjod par bya ba nyid du bstan pa gang yin pa de ni rgyan gyi brjod par bya ba'o/ /gang gis na/ bcom ldan 'das sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul/ gsung rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul| thugs kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum gyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la gdams ngag rjes su ston par mdzad pa de nyid kyis so/ /gang na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos bcu ni/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam ste/ rtsa bar dngos su bstan pa ni mtshon byed do/ /ci'i phyir rnam mkhyen gcig pu las mi ston zhe na/ 'dis nye bar mtshon nas mngon par rtogs pa gzhan bdun po thams cad gtso bo'i brjod byar lhur len pa yin no/

/'brel ba ni/ rjod par byed pa mngon rtogs rgyan dang*/ des brjod par bya ba mngon par rtogs pa de dag thabs dang*/ rgyan thabs las byung tshul gyis byams pas 'brel ba mdzad pa dag go /nying dgos ni/ rnam pa thams cad mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro| |zhes drang ngo*/ /gang na/ chos 'di la phyi rol pa dang de'i cig shos kyi khams gsum la 'dod chags dang bral ba nyan rang dgra bcom pa sogs chos thams cad bdag med pa/ shin tu rgyas pa'i lam la goms par ma byas pa rnams kyis thos pa las byung ba la sogs pa'i shes pa skye ba'i rim gyis ma myangs pa'i sher phyin de'o/ /gang gis mngon du byed ce na/ byang chub sems dpa' rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa sgrub pa'i thabs gzhan ci la yang ma reg par byang chub tu chas pa dag kho nas so （23ba）gang la brten nas she na/ 'di la ring ba'i rgyu ni sher phyin gyi don legs par bzhag nas zhes drang ngo*| |gang la na/ sngar myong ba'i don mi brjed pa'i dran pa'i shes pa la'o/ /de gang zhe na/ mdo'i don nyams su myong ba'i thos bsam gyi shes pa shin tu gsal bas sems rgyud la bzhag pa'i bag chags las byung ba'o/ /gang na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i don ma lus pa'o/ /de yang gang zhe na/ mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi bdag nyid do/ /tshul ji ltar na/ spyod pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa bcu sgrub pa'i spyod pa ste/ rtsa bar chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid ces smos pas so/ /nye ba'i rgyu ni/ de ltar dran pa la bzhag pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam skyes te/ chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba'i don rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid sa dang po rab tu dga' ba dang*| gnyis pa dri ma med pa la sogs pa rtogs pa'i rim pas so/ /dgos pa ni| tshegs chung ngus bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ba ni/ bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin no/

/zhes brjod do/ /gang rtogs na| thob par mngon par 'dod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don smon pa byang chub kyi sems 'jug pa'i spyod pa dang*/ sbyin sogs phar phyin bcu sgrub pa'i spyod pa dang*/ sogs pas chos sku 'phrin las dang bcas pa grub pa'i spyod pa ste spyod pa gsum gyi mtshan nyid do/ /dgos pa de nyid gang gi ched du yin/ zhe na| dgos pa'i yang dgos pa'i nying dgos kyi ched du yin no/ /gang gis na/ rgyan gyi gdul bya rnams kyis so/ /mdor na dgos 'brel gyi don nyams len la sbyor na blo 'di lta bu zhig bskyed dgos so/ /log rtog bzhi bkag nas dgos sogs chos bzhi bstan pa ni nang pa'i bstan pa la mi 'jug pa'i phyi rol pa lta bu ma gtogs/ nang pa la bstan bcos rgyan la dgos med kyi log rtog skye ba dka'| rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnams kyi bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i tshul bstan pa yin/ da lta rang nyid tshod tsam la 'phags pa byams pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos yin pas dgos pa yod pa las 'os med snyam pa'i blo zhig skye dgos pa yin/ de la brjod bya dngos po brgyad yin/ de bsdu na/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje dang*/ bde ba dang ldan 'dod kyi byams pa dang sher phyin la dang ba'i dad pa ste/ de gsum bcos ma ma yin pa zhig gis drangs pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa 'jug pa'i spyod pa dang*| des zin pa'i sgo nas phar phyin bcu la tshul bzhin nyams su len pa'i sgrub pa'i spyod pa dang de la brten nas 'bras bu chos sku 'phrin las dang bcas pa thob pa ni （24na）grub pa'i spyod pa ste mdo'i don spyod pa gsum du bsdus nas nyams su len tshul bstan to/ /bde blag tu rtogs pa'i don yang mdo'i don shin tu rtogs dka' ba mngon rtogs rgyan la brten nas tshegs chung ngus rtogs pas na/ mngon rtogs rgyan ni mdo'i don sgom pa'i man ngag lta bur go ba zhig dgos/

gsung rab dri ma med pa nas ma bshad pa'i man ngag zab mo yin zer ba re la rtsis byed pa ni/ rgya mtshor nor bu len pa dor ste/ ba glang gi rmig rjes la nor bu 'tshol ba dang 'dra/ de bas byams pa'i man ngag la brten nas/ sher phyin gyi don sgom pa 'di bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ dran pa'i shes pa la bzhag zer ba yang thos bsam gyis yang yang yid la byas nas ma brjed pa'i dran pa dang*/ shes bzhin gyis zin pa zhig dgos te/ tshe rabs gzhan dang gzhan du yang sher phyin gyi don sgom pa zhig 'ong zhes pa'i don yin/ legs par bzhag ces pa yang shes pa yin no/ /zhes tshig zin pa tsam la'ang mi bya/ bshes gnyen bzang po la gtugs nas tshul bzhin du rtogs pa zhig gi bag chags bzhag ces pa'i don yin/ des na de lta bu'i nyams su len rgyu dang 'bras bu thob rgyu zhig 'dug na/ ci'i phyir mi 'jug snyam pa'i blo bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skyes na/ bstan bcos kyi lus kyi staun pa ltar sher phyin gyi don nyams su len tshul rgyas par bstan pa la/ dang ba dang*/ gus pa dang*/ yid dga' spro dang bcas te/ sbyor ba nan tur gyis 'jug pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ de yang gzhung gis de ltar bstan pa yin/ rjes 'jug gi gdul bya gzhan zhig gis 'jug pa yin no/ /zhes gzhan gyi lan mos bskyar ba bzhin du ma song bar rang nyid kyi rgyud la ci skye skye dgos pa yin gsung*/ des na dgos 'brel gcig pus kyang lam nyams su len pa'i rim pa 'bras bu dang bcas pa bstan ta

ོ / / ga3 bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin bshad pa las/ nga1 bstan bcos kyi lus rnam gzhag bshad pa/ gsum pa la gsum/ rgyas pa la dad pa la brgyad/ bar ma la dad pa la drug bsdus pa la dad pa la gsum du dbye'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ bsdus don lus rnam bzhag tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad do/ /dang po la bzhi/ dgos pa bstan pas mtshams sbyar/ dgos ldan lus bshad/ lus kyi bsdus tshul bstan/ tshig don rgyas par ma bkrol ba'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ de ltar bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag 'brel ba la sogs pa bzhi bsnyad nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lus rnam par bzhag pa gsungs so/ /gang gis na/ tshig le'ur byas pa bco lngas so/ /ji ltar na/ dang po gnyis kyi mdor bstan pa dang*/ lhag ma bcu gsum gyis rgyas par bstan pas so/ /dgos pa gang gi don du na/ nyan pa pos nyan sla ba dang*/ 'chad pa pos 'chad sla ba'i dgos pa gnyis gzigs nas so/ /de la dang po ni/ gdul bya rnams kyis tshig nyung ngus bstan bcos kyi don mtha' dag che long gi sgo nas bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*| gnyis pa ni/ bstan bcos kyi don rnam par dbye ba byas pa yang lus dang mthun par ma 'dzings pa nyid kyis yan lag rgyas bshad du bshad par bya sla ba'o| | gnyis pa la gnyis/ lus mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ yum dngos brgyad kyis bshad par bstan/ 'chad byed dngos brgyad gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mchod brjod du sangs rgyas kyi ni yum de la phyag 'tshal/ zhes brjod pa'i bstod phyag gi yul gyi sher phyin de gang zhe na/ bshad do zhes drang ngo*/ gang na/ mchod brjod kyi yul shes rab pha rol tu phyin pa ni'o/ /gang gi sgo nas zhe na/ dngos po brgyad kyis sgo nas so/ /ji ltar na/ mdo ji lta ba bzhin ston pas na yang dag par ro/ /mdo las ji skad bstan zhe na| le'u brgyad ma ltar na/ gleng bzhi'i mjug thogs nas brtsams te/

rab 'byor gyi le'us rnam mkhyen/ mtha' gnyis rnam dag gi le'us lam shes/ spyod pa khyad par can gyi le'us gzhi shes/ de bzhin nyid kyi le'us rnam kun/ bslab pa yongs su dag pa'i le'us rtse sbyor/ rim gyis 'jug pa la bslab pa'i le'us mthar gyis pa/ bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'us skad cig ma/ bslab pa'i 'bras bu'i le'us chos sku bstan to/ /'dir sher phyin la dbye na/ gzhung dang*/ lam dang*/ 'bras bu'i sher phyin gsum mo/ /chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis/ chos rnams kyi de bzhin nyid chos rnams las de nyid dang*/ gzhan nyid du brjod par bya ba ma yin pa ni rang bzhin gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ zhes pa dang*| de'i phyir rang bzhin gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni/ gtso bo'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ zhes rang bzhin gyi sher phyin dang bzhi ru 'chad do/ / gnyis pa la gsum/ dngos brgyad so so'i rang bzhin/ grangs nges pa'o| |go rim nges pa'o/ /dang po la brgyad las/ dang po ni/ rnam kun mkhyen nyid ces pas ni mtshon bya bstan to/ /bden gnyis kyi rnam pa ma lus pa mkhyen zhing don gnyis mthar thug pa'i ye shes ni mtshan nyid do/ /dbye na/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa gnyis so/ /chos can gyi rnam dbye mi 'dra ba du ma mkhyen pa'i cha nas ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen dang*/ de bzhin nyid thams cad ro gcig pa'i rnam par mkhyen pa'i cha nas ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen zhes bya'o/ /tshul ji ltar mkhyen ce na （25na）chos can la gnyis snang dang bcas pa'i sgo nas mkhyen la/ chos nyid la gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis mkhyen no/ /mkhyen tshul mi 'dra ba tsam du zad kyi ye shes gnyis kas kyang shes bya thams cad la 'jug ste/ bden gnyis las/ mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig gis ni/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab can/ /zhes so/

/sa mtshams sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nas bsdus so/ / gnyis pa ni/ lam shes nyid ces pa ni mtshon bya'o/ /mtshan nyid ni thabs shes khyad par can dang ldan pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i ye shes/ dbye na/ dmigs yul lam gsum gyi dbye bas gsum mo/ /sa mtshams sa dang po nas rgyun mtha'i bar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid ces pas mtshon bya bstan la/ mtshan nyid ni/ gzhi bdag med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis zin cing bsam pa rang don zhi bde don gnyer gyi theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa'o/ /dbye na/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes gnyis so/ /sa mtshams theg dman 'phags pa'i rgyud kho na la yod/ /bzhi pa ni/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa ni zhes pas mtshon bya bstan la/ mtshan nyid ni/ dbang du bya ba'i phyir mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsdus nas sgom pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor| dbye na rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga ste nyi shu'o| |sa mtshams theg pa chen po'i tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ lnga pa ni/ rtse mor phyin dang zhes pas mtshon bya bstan la/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor/ dbye na| sbyor lam rtse sbyor sogs bzhi'o/ /sa mtshams theg pa chen po'i sbyor lam drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar ro/ /drug pa ni/ mthar gyis pa zhes pas mtshon bya bstan la/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsdus sgom brtan pa'i don du rim gyis sgom pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor/ dbye na/ mthar gyis pa bcu gsum mo/ /sa mtshams theg pa chen po'i tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod| bdun pa ni/ skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang ces pas mtshon bya bstan la/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsdus sgom mthar thug pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor/ dbye na/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas bzhi/

sa mtshams rgyun mtha' kho na la yod/ brgyad pa ni/ chos kyi sku dang zhes pas mtshon bya bstan la/ mtshan nyid ni/ sbyor bzhi sgom pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug dbye na/ sku bzhi'o/ /sa mtshams ni sangs rgyas kyi yon tan kho nas bsdus pa'o/ / （25ba） gnyis pa ni/ de rnams brgyad ni tshig nges bzung gi snying po can te/ grangs nges pa bstan to/ /ci'i phyir dngos brgyad du nges she na/ de la dz+nyā na shrī ltar na/ rten gyi gang zag bzhi'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal chen po ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs la snying rje dang bral ba gnyis dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu'i sa pa sa bcu pa de nyid la gnas te sems can gyi don sgrub kyi gtan sangs mi rgya ba spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa dang*/ byams pa la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i rigs can gyi byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgya ba'i gang zag go /de la mkhyen pa gsum gyis ni de dag gi lam rim pa bzhin du bstan to/ /sbyor ba bzhis de dag so so'i nyams su len pa'i rim pa bstan to/ /chos skus ni de dag gi 'bras bu mi 'dra ba bzhi bstan to/ /de yang nyan rang gi chos sku ni rjes su mthun pa'i sku gsum mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'tshang mi rgya ba la gnas skabs kyi chos sku'o/ /'tshang rgya ba la mthar thug gi chos sku'o/ /des na lam dang de nyams su len pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ 'bras bu gsum gyi dbang du byas te brgyad du nges so/ /zhes so/ / slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen ltar na/ rgyan gyi gdul bya theg pa gsum la rim gyis zhugs pa'i ched du theg pa gsum gyi lam rnams bstan par bzhed do/ /a bh+ya ltar na/ sems bskyed nyer gnyis lam gyi gzhir byas mngon rtogs gzhan rnams de la sbyar nas nyams su len par byed/ ces bzhed do/ / yang lam rkyang khug gnyis su smra ba las/ lam rkyang pa'i 'dod tshul ni/ lam ring bul smra ba rnams na re/

ra zam pa la sbreng ba ltar/ rnam mkhyen mos spyod kyi sa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar dang*/ lam shes sa dang po nas drug pa'i bar dang*| gzhi shes sa bdun pa dang*/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sa brgyad pa dang*/ rtse mo sa dgu pa dang bcu pa'i dkyil stod dang*/ mthar gyis pa sa bcu pa'i smad la dang*| skad cig ma'i sbyor ba sa bcu rgyun mtha' dang*/ 'bras bu chos sku sangs rgyas kyi sar nyams su len par byed do/ /lam khug pa'i 'dod tshul ni/ skabs dang po gsum gyi rgyu 'bras tshar gcig skabs phyi ma lngas rgyu 'bras tshar gcig ste| rgyu 'bras phrugs gnyis bstan pas/ lam khug pa rgyan gyi dgongs pa yin no| |zhes zer ro/ / yang mkhas pa phal mo che rnams na re/ theg pa chen po'i rigs can rten gyi gang zag cig sangs rgya ba'i dbang du byas nas brgyad du nges te/ shes par bya ba'i yul dang*/ nyams su len pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ thob bya'i 'bras bu gsum du nges la/ de yang dang po la mkhyen gsum （26na）dang*/ gnyis pa la sbyor bzhi dang*/ gsum pa la chos sku nges te/ don bsdus sgron me las/ shes bya'i yul du mkhyen pa gsum/ /sgom pa'i dus su sbyor ba bzhi/ /'bras bu mthar thug chos kyi sku/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ci'i phyir gsum du nges she na/ thog mar shes bya'i yul gtan la 'bebs dgos te/ yul ma shes na sbyor ba nyams su len mi shes pa'i phyir/ dper na so nam gyi sbyar thabs ma shes na de lag tu blang mi nus pa bzhin no/ /shes nas nyams su len dgos te yul shes kyang sbyor ba nyams su ma blangs par 'bras bu mi 'thob pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na so nam ma byas par lo thog mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /thob bya'i 'bras bu zhig nges par dgos te/ de med na sbyor ba nyams su blangs pa don med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dper na lo tog sad ser gyis khyer ba bzhin no/ /shes par bya ba'i yul la gsum du nges pa'i rgyu mtshan yang gang zhe na/

'bras bu rnam mkhyen ma bstan na rgyu lam shes la nan tan gyis 'jug par mi 'gyur bas 'bras bu la brod pa bskyed pa'i ched du dang por rnam mkhyen bstan to/ /de thob pa yang lam shes la rag las pas rgyu thun mong ma yin pa lam shes bstan to/ /de yang gzhi yongs su shes pa la rag las pas gol sa gcod pa'i yan lag tu gzhi shes bstan te/ dper na tshong pas tshong gi khe thos nas de'i thabs la 'jug cing thabs ma yin pa las ldog pa bzhin no/ /de yang snga ma las/ thos bsam dus su 'bras bu dang*/ /rgyu dang mi mthun phyogs dag tu/ /gtan la phab pa rdzogs pa yin/ /zhes so/ /'o na nyams su len pa'i sbyor ba la bzhir ji ltar nges she na/ slob dpon seng bzang ltar na/ dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras dang*/ brtan pa rgyu 'bras gnyis so/ /'phags pa ltar na/ dang po gnyis rnal 'byor sgom pa gtso bor gyur pa'i sbyor ba yin/ phyi ma gnyis spyod pa rjes su sgrub pa gtso bor gyur pa'i sbyor ba yin zhes bzhed do/ /snga ma las/ sgom pa'i dus su sbyor ba dang*| |gnas skabs 'bras bu brtan byed dang*/ /rgyu yi 'bras bu dag gis rdzogs/ /zhes so/ /de rnams kyi 'thad mi 'thad kyi dgag sgrub tshigs mangs su dogs nas ma bris so/ /dngos po brgyad la thos bsam gyi skabs dang*/ nyams len gyi skabs so sor byed pa mi 'thad de/ skabs brgyad ka la thos bsam yang byed la nyams len byed par yang khyad par med pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan du na/ skabs 'og ma bzhi thos bsam gyis gtan la phab/ nyams su len pa mkhyen pa gsum gyi skabs zhes ldog ste smras na yang gnod byed med par sems so/ /des na skabs brgyad ka la thos bsam yang （26ba）byed la nyams len yang byed do| |nyams su len tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ theg chen du 'jug sgo sems bskyed dang*| sems bskyed kyi dam bcas pa'i don sgrub pa gnyis su bsdus nas lam thams cad de'i khongs su bsgrigs nas nyams su len par byed ces gsungs so|

|de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su shes pa ni dbang du bya ba'i phyir yang*| zhes sogs rnam kun gyi mtshams sbyar gyis mkhyen gsum shes bya'i ldog pa nas bstan cing sbyor ba nyams len gyi sgo nas bstan to/ / yul ni rnam pa gsum po rgyu/ /zhes sogs rtsa 'grel gyis kyang de ltar bstan te/ 'grel par/ dang por rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la sogs pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi ngo bo nyid ni 'jug pa'i yul gyi rgyu yin no// de ji ltar rab tu sbyor zhe na/ zhes sogs kyi yang snga ma ltar gsungs shing dang por zhes dang de'i 'og tu zhes go rim nges pa can du yang gsungs pas mtshon bya dngos po brgyad/ de nyid mtshon byed don bdun cu gnyis kyi dbang du byas nas mtshon bya mngon rtogs brgyad kyi ngo bo tsam la shes par bya ba'i yul nyams su len pa sbyor ba/ thob bya'i 'bras bu gsum du nges zhes sogs 'brel sgrig tshul snga ma ltar ro/ /mtshon byed don bdun cu la thos bsam dang nyams len gnyis char byed par mtshungs so/ /des na skabs brgyad kyi mtshams sbyar ni dngos po brgyad kyi ngo bo tsam gyi 'brel bstan la/ de yang gtso bor thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i dbang du byas so/ /don bdun cu ni gtso bor nyams su len pa'i lam gyi dmigs rnam mi 'dra ba du ma bstan nas lam gyi myong ba 'don pa'i rim pa rnams bstan ta ོ / /des na/ sems mi 'gong ba nyid la sogs| |zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen bstan ta ོ / /sbyor ba'i yon tan dang*/ skyon gnyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul la sbyar ro/ /de yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul phyin ci ma log pa gnad du song ba zhig byung na/ sbyor ba sgom pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung bas sbyor ba'i yon tan bcu bzhi bstan/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa gnad du ma song na phal cher dpon slob tshogs pa'i chos spyod las nyams pa sbyor ba'i skyon bzhi cu zhe drug 'byung bas de bstan ta

ོ / /sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis sher phyin gyi don sgom pa'i snod ldan gyi gang zag bstanato/ /mdor na theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa dang tshul bzhin du bsten nas mnyes par byas pa zhig dang*/ sher phyin gyi don sgom （27na）pa la snod ldan gyi gang zag dgos zhes ston te/ rang rgyud la sbyar nas bshes gnyen 'tshol ba dang*/ bsten pa dang*| rgyud snod rung du sgrub pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /'o na sher phyin gyi don ji ltar nyams su len zhe na/ gzhung gzhan thams cad sher phyin gyi don ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul la sbyar bar bya ste/ de yang bsam pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni dam bca' lta bu/ de nyid kyi dam bcas pa'i don sgrub pa bzhi'am/ sbyor ba bzhir 'dus la mngon rtogs gzhan rnams de'i khongs su bsgrigs nas nyams su len pa'i tshul rnams sbyor bar byed do/ /lam gyi sdom de gnyis kyang*/ lam gyi myong ba 'don tshul dang*/ dmigs rnam mi 'dra ba tsam ma gtogs/ lam gyi rdzas sam rigs la khyad par med/ myong ba mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'don tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ bsam pa gtso bor byas nas go cha'i sgrub pa bstan/ sbyor ba gtso bor byas nas 'jug pa'i sgrub pa bstan/ bsam sbyor gnyis kyis nyams su blangs pa la brten nas/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs du ma bsags pas tshogs kyi sgrub pa rang shugs la 'grub pa yin/

tshogs kyi sgrub pa la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis 'bad pas mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i nges 'byung sgrub pa yang rang shugs la thob bo/ /de nyid la goms pas 'byung sa mthar thug tu phyin pa yin no/ /sbyor ba bzhi la yang dbang thob pa'i phyir du sgom pa rnam kun dang*| dbang thob nas sgom pa'i gnas skabs rtse sbyor dang*/ brtan pa thob don du sgom pa mthar gyis pa dang*/ brtan pa thob nas sgom pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'o| |gal te sbyor ba rnams 'gal bar 'gyur te/ dbang thob ma thob dang*/ brtan pa thob ma thob 'gal ba'i phyir ro zhe na/ skyon med de/ nus pa cung zad cig ma thob pa thob pa'i phyir du sgom pa dang*/ cung zad cig thob pa'i snga phyi gnyis 'gal yang*/ de las nus pa lhag pa zhig thob pa'i phyir du sgom pa dang*/ de las kyang nus pa ches lhag pa ma thob pa thob pa'i phyir du sgom pa ni 'bras bu mthar thug ma thob kyi bar du nus pa snga ma snga ma las/ phyi ma phyi ma gong nas gong du ches cher 'gyur te/ dper na rtsal slob pa bzhin no/ /des na ltos sa gcig la ltos nas 'gal la/ ltos sa tha dad la ltos nas mi 'gal bar shes par byas te/ brtan pa rgyu 'bras la yang de bzhin no/ /sgrub pa bzhi dang*/ sbyor ba bzhi la lam gyi myong ba 'don tshul 'di ni/ rang rang gi skabs nas nang tshan gyi dmigs rnam mi 'dra ba du ma bstan pa thams cad la sbyar bar bya ste/ lam gyi myong ba 'don pa'i man ngag tu （27ba）shes par bya'o/ /de'i phyir dngos brgyad ngo bo tsam gyi 'brel dang*/ don bdun cu'i 'brel phyogs gcig tu mi bzung ste/ dper na/ rnam mkhyen thob bya'i 'bras bur bstan la/ rnam mkhyen gyi chos bcu gtso bor rgyu'i ldog pa nas bstan pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin du don bdun cu'i ngo bo tsam gyi 'brel dang*/ nang tshan gyi 'brel rnams kyang mi gcig par shes par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang*/

/zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya dang*/ lam nyams su len pa'i rim pa bstan zhing*/ mngon rtogs gzhan rnams de'i dmigs skor du sbyar nas kyang 'chad do/ /zhes bdag gi bla ma gsung ste/ rang rang gi skabs su bshad par bya'o/ /de la 'dir lam gyi myong ba 'don tshul rgyas pa ni/ gzhung gi skabs su bstan pa rnams yin la/ spyir sher phyin gyi don yid la byed pa'i tshul ni| brgyad stong 'grel pa las/ sa phyogs gtsang mar stan bde ba la/ rdo rje skyil mo krung bcas te/ rtsa ba'am dngos gzhi'i sems kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /de la dmigs pa'i sems drug ste/ rtsa ba'am dngos gzhi'i sems/ rjes su dpyod pa'i sems/ rnam par dpyod pa'i sems| nges par 'dzin pa'i sems/ sdom pa'i sems/ smon pa'am re ba'i sems so/ /dang po ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de nas dang por sdom brtson ste/ / mdo yi sde la sogs pa yi/ /mi gnyis don ni rab 'byed pa/ /mdo sogs ming la sems 'jog go /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhung 'grel gyi mtshan tsam la dmigs pa 'dzin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas de ni rim bzhin du/ /tshig rab 'byed la dpyod byed cing*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhung gi dbu nas zhabs kyi bar la/ don tshan ston pa'i tshig du yod dpyod pa'o/ / gsum pa ni/ so so'i nang nas tshul bzhin du/ /de yi don la rnam par dpyod/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ yi ge la dpyod pa ni/ gzhung gi tshig re re la zhib tu dpyod pa'o/ /don la dpyod pa la yang*/ bgrang ba dang*/ gzhal ba dang*/ brtag pa dang*/ rtog pa'i rnam pa bzhi gsungs pa las/ dang po ni/ dngos brgyad don bdun cu de rnams kyi nang gses gyi dbye ba rnams la dpyod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ grangs de las mang bar sgro 'dogs pa dang*/ nyung bar skur pa 'debs pa'i mtha' gnyis sel ba la dpyod pa'o/

/gsum pa ni/ gzhung gis bstan pa'i don rnams la tshad mas brtags nas/ gnod pa yod dam med ces dpyod par byed do/ /bzhi pa ni/ dang po gsum ka'i sgo nas kyang rtog par byed de/ tshig don thams cad la rtog par byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ don de dag ni nges bzung nas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar| snga ma （28na）rnams kyis ji ltar dpyad pa'i don de kho na bzhin du yin nges snyam du rang gi rgyud la nar mar sems shing 'dzin pa yin no/ /lnga pa ni/ chos la kun nas sdom par byed/ /ces gsungs pas/ dbu zhabs kyi tshig don thams cad ril gyis bsdoms nas sgom par byed do/ /drug pa ni/ de yi don ni thob bya'i phyir/ /de dag la ni smon par byed/ /ces gsungs pas/ 'bras bu la re ba 'cha' zhing smon pa'o/ /mdor na/ rnyed bkur dang grags pa sogs la mi lta zhing*/ nges 'byung dang*/ skyo shas drag pos kun nas bslangs te/ byams pa dang snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems gsum gyis zin par byas nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshig don rnams la yang dang yang du sems par byed pa'i sgo nas goms pa lhur len par bya'o/ /gsum pa go rim nges pa ni/ de nas zhes pas ni go rim bstan te/ mkhyen gsum gyi ngo bo tsam ni bshad pa'i rim pa dang*| sbyor bzhi dang*/ chos sku don gyi rim pa'o/ / gnyis pa la gsum/ mkhyen pa gsum/ sbyor ba bzhi/ chos sku'i lus cung zhig rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum rnam mkhyen/ lam shes/ gzhi shes so/ /dang po la gsum/ ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul/ chos bcu'i rang bzhin/ gang dang 'brel ba'i rten bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bden gnyis las/ gang tshe shes dang shes bya dag /bdag nyid rjes su mi mthong ba/ /de ni mtshan ma mi 'byung phyir/ /gnas pa brtan phyir mi bzhengs so/ /zhes dang*/ brtags pa'i don gyis dben pa yi/ /ji ltar snang ba 'di kho na/ /brten te skyes pa thams cad ni|

|thams cad mkhyen pas mngon sum gzigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa 'di lta bu'o/ /zhes ngo bo'i sgo nas mi ston par/ chos bcu'i sgo nas ston pa ma 'brel lo zhe na/ 'di la lo ts+tsha ba chen po na re/ rgyus mtshon nas 'bras bu bstan pa yin te/ rgyu ni sgrub pa yin la/ de yang rten dang*| dmigs pa dang*/ ched du bya ba dang*/ rang gi ngo bo ste bzhi'o/ /rten yang chos bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ bsam pa'i khyad par sems bskyed pa dang*/ thob bya'i khyad par gdam ngag dang rjes su bstan pa thob pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i khyad par nges 'byed cha mthun la gnas pa dang*/ rigs kyi khyad par chos kyi dbyings kyi rigs dang ldan pas so/ /rten des dmigs pa bcu gcig la dmigs nas ched du bya ba gsum gyi ched du sgrub pa bzhi byas pas de 'thob pa yin te/ rin chen sgron ma las/ rgyu bcu rdzogs pas 'bras bu kun mkhyen nyid/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan dag yul gyis yul can mtshon nas bstan pa yin te/ 'grel （28ba）chen gyi le'u dang po'i mthar sems bskyed pa la sogs pa rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos kyi rnam pa ma lus pa nyams su blang bar bya bas spyod par 'gyur ba zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar gsungs kyang mtshon nas bstan pa tsam la phyogs gnyis ka nas kyang bshad par nus so/ / gnyis pa la gsum/ snod rung gi rten dang*/ dam bca' dang*/ dam bcas pa'i don sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang*/ /zhes pa'o/ /'di 'og tu bshad pa ni dang por 'bras bu rigs kyi rtags bstan nas/ rgyu rigs phyis bstan na rigs rtogs sla ba la dgongs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems bskyed pa'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ sngon 'gro'i chos dang*/ dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po la gsum/ sgrub pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ gang la dmigs pa'i yul/ gang gi ched du sgrub pa'i bya ba'o/

/ dang po la gnyis/ bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sems bskyed de bstan zin to / /gnyis pa la gnyis/ ring sbyor dang*/ nye sbyor ro/ /dang po ni/ gdam ngag go /gnyis pa ni/ nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dmigs pa dag dang zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ched dang ni/ zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang*/ /tshogs ni nges par 'byung bcas rnams zhes pa ste/ 'brel sngar bstan zin to/ /gsum pa ni/ thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ /ces so/ / gnyis pa la gsum/ lam shes kyi chos bcu gcig rten gyi gang zag de ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ lam shes skye ba'i rgyu/ lam shes kyi rang bzhin no/ /dang po la gnyis/ 'gal rkyen dang bral ba'i khyad par/ mthun rkyen tshang ba'i khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ mog mog por byed ces pas bstan to/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ la sogs pa zhes pa ste lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen| nye bar len pa'i rgyu'o/ /dang po ni/ yul nges kyis ston no/ /gnyis pa ni/ khyab pas ston no/ /gnyis pa lam shes kyi rang bzhin la gnyis/ thabs snying rje chen po dang*/ lam gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab bo/ /dang po ni/ nyon mongs mi spong ba'i rang bzhin dang*/ gzhan don bya ba'i las gnyis kyis bstan to/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs shes par bya ba'i mngon rtogs/ rang smin pa'i thabs su mngon du bya ba'i mngon rtogs so/ / dang po ni/ slob ma bse ru'i lam gang dang*/ /zhes pas bstan to/ /gnyis pa la gnyis| sgrib pa phyogs gcig spang ba dang*/ mtha' dag spang ba'i lam mo/ / dang po ni/ 'di dang gzhan pa'i yon tan gyi/ /phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam// zhes pa'o/ /gnyis （29na）pa la gnyis/ byed pa dang*/ byed pa can gyi sgom lam mo/ /dang po ni/ byed pa dang ni/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rjes thob kyi nyams len zag bcas sgom lam dang*/

mnyam bzhag gi nyams len zag med sgom lam mo/ /dang po la/ mos bsngo yi rang gsum mo/ /dang po la gnyis| mos pa dngos dang*/ phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ mos pa dang zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ bstod dang bkur dang bsngags pa dang*/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni| bsngo dang zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rjes su yi rang ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ yon tan mngon par sgrub pa dang*/ dri ma rnam par dag par byed pa'i sgom lam mo/ /dang po ni/ sgrub dang zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ shin tu dag pa'o/ /des na mos pa nas dag pa zhes bya ba'i bar lnga po 'di ni byed pa can gyi sgom pa'i lam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi'o/ /gsum pa ni/ lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad/ /ces pa'o| | gsum pa la gsum/ gzhi shes kyi chos dgu'i rang bzhin/ rten gyi gang zag ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum/ 'jug par bya ba'i yul// 'jug pa sbyor ba/ zhugs 'bras mthong lam mo/ /dang po la gsum/ gzhi shes kyi ngo bo/ nye ring gi rgyu mtshan/ mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*/ /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dang zhes pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang*/ /thabs kyis ring ba ma yin nyid/ /ces pa gnyis so/ /gsum pa ni/ mi mthun gnyen po'i phyogs dag dang*/ zhes pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa 'jug pa sbyor ba la gnyis/ dngos dang*| rnam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sbyor dang zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de yi mnyam nyid dang*/ /zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ byang sems kyi mthong ba'i lam mo/ / gnyis pa rten gyi gang zag ni/ nyan thos la sogs zhes pa'o/ /'brom 'gyur las| mthong lam nyan thos la sogs pa zhes 'byung ste 'gyur de bde'o/ / gsum pa ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul ni/ de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod/ /zhes pa'o| | gnyis pa sbyor ba la gnyis/ dbang du bya ba rgyu 'bras dang*/

brtan pa rgyu 'bras so/ /dang po la gnyis/ rnam kun dang*/ rtse mo'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rnam kun gyi chos bcu gcig dang*/ ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis| rnam kun tsam gyi sgom rim dang*/ rnam kun khyad par can gyi sgom rim mo| |dang po la gsum/ bsgom bya dang*/ sgom pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ sngon 'gro'i chos so/ /dang po ni/ rnam pa zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyor bar bcas rnams （29ba）zhes so/ /gsum pa la bzhi/ blang bya/ dor bya/ shes bya/ shes pa po'i gang zag ste/ rim pa bzhin/ yon tan skyon ni mtshan nyid bcas/ /thar dang zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ /sbyor ba skyes pa'i gnas skabs/ rten gyi gang zag nus pa mthu can du 'gyur ba'i sbyor ba'o/ /dang po gnyis ni/ nges 'byed cha mthun dang*/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa la| chos sku'i rgyu srid zhi mnyam pa nyid kyi sbyor ba/ gzugs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba/ 'phrin las kyi rgyu thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba dang gsum ste rim pa ltar| srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid dang*/ /zhes pa dang*/ zhing dag bla na med pa ni/ /zhes pa dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa yin/ /zhes pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni| rnam pa nas thabs la mkhas pa dang bcas pa bcu gcig po 'di ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa ste zhes so/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ rtse mo'i chos brgyad/ de ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul lo| |dang po la gnyis/ 'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rtse sbyor ro/ /dang po la gzhi las/ drod kyi rtse sbyor ni/ rtse sbyor de yi rtags bcu gnyis kyis mtshon nas bstan pa'o/ /rtse mo ni/ rnam 'phel bcu drug gis mtshon nas bstan pa'o/ /bzod pa ni/ brtan pa gnyis kyis mtshon nas bstan pa'o| |chos mchog ni/ /bsod nams mang po dang ldan pa'i sems kun tu gnas pas mtshon nas bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ mthong lam/

sgom lam| bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor ro/ /dang po ni/ mthong zhes bya ba'i lam ni/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa rnam pa bzhi'i gnyen po rnam pa bzhi dang bcas pa'o| |gnyis pa ni/ sgom pa zhes bya ba'i lam ni/ so so la rnam par rtog pa rnam pa bzhi'i gnyen po rnam pa bzhi dang bcas pa'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ bsal bya'o/ /dang po ni/ bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ / zhes pa'o gnyis pa ni/ log par sgrub dang zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtags nas log sgrub dang bcas pa'i bar brgyad ni rtse mo'i mngon rtogs so/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ mthar gyis pa dang*/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sbyor ba phun tshogs phar phyin drug bsam pa phun tshogs rjes dran drug de rnams dag byed dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba ste/ rnam gsum rnam bcu zhes pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ skad cig ma gcig gis mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub pa zhes bya'o/ /dbye na/ ye shes gcig nyid/ mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba nyid kyis rnam pa bzhi'o/ / gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku ni/ rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag par brjod pa'o| |gang zhe na/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang*/ /de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni/ /（30na）chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ tshig bcad bco lnga yod pa de la/ tshig le'ur byas pa dang po gnyis kyis ni lus mdor bstan pa yin te/ dngos po brgyad tsam du bsdus te bstan pa'i phyir ro// tshig le'ur byas pa lhag ma bcu gsum gyis ni lus cung zad rgyas par bshad pa yin te/ dngos brgyad de dag nyid kyi don bdun cu'i grangs tsam du bsdus nas bshad pa'i phyir ro/

/de ltar na rgyan gyi lus legs par bshad pa yin te/ dngos po brgyad du bsdus pa dang*/ de las cung zhig rgyas par don bdun cur phye nas bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ ci'i phyir don bdun cu'i tshig don rgyas par mi 'chad ce na/ bsdus pa'i don gyi tshig le'ur byas pa bco lnga po rnams ni yan lag rgyas bshad kyi gong 'dir rgyas par rnam par ma bkrol lo/ /rgyu mtshan ni| zlos pa'i nyes par 'gyur du dogs nas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ bstan bcos mdzad pa byams pa nyid kyis sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos mtha' dag gis lus rnam gzhag 'chad pas na/ yan lag rgyas bshad de dag rnam par bshad pas lus rnam gzhag kyang bshad par bsams te'o/ / nga2 yan lag rgyas par bshad pa las/ ca1 yul mkhyen pa gsum rgyas par bshad pa/ gnyis pa yan lag rgyas bshad la gsum/ 'jug yul mkhyen pa gsum/ 'jug pa sbyor ba bzhi/ zhugs 'bras chos sku'i yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum/ 'bras bu thun mong ma yin pa rnam mkhyen/ rgyu thun mong ma yin pa lam shes/ blang dor thun mong ma yin pa gzhi shes kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / skabs dang po/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu bshad pa las/ cha1 sems bskyed bshad pa/ dang po la gsum/ 'brel dgod pas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi chos bcu rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bshad par bzhed de zhes drang ngo*/ /gang na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de brjod byar sdud pa'i lus rnam gzhag gi tshig le'ur byas pa rnams so/ ji ltar na/ rnam par ste rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas so/ /nam gyi tshe na/ de ltar bsdus pa'i don lus rnam gzhag kun bstan zin nas skabs brgyad kyi dang por ro/ /rgyu mtshan ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par bya dgos pas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang*|

don du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu mthar thug yin pa'i phyir ro/ su zhig gis thob par bya zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rjes su thob par 'dod pas so// gnyis pa la bzhi/ bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ sbyor ba la 'jug pa'i tshul gdam ngag nod pa/ sbyor ba nges 'byed yan lag gdams pa'i don phyin ci ma log par sgrub pa'o/ / dang po la bzhi/ sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs yul/ rab dbye/ sa mtshams so/ /dang po （30ba）la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ sems bskyed pa rang gi ngo bo dmigs pa dang bcas pa'o/ /rtsa ba ni/ mdo las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces bka' bstsal pa/ sha ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes pa nas/ sems can yongs su smin pa'i rgyur 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po rnams nye bar len pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis ni sems bskyed bstan ta ོ / /de dag gi don bsdus nas ston pa ni/ sems bskyed pa ni/ /zhes mtshon bya bstan to/ /gzhan don phyir yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces pas mtshan nyid bstan to/ /de yang 'bras bu byang chub 'dod pa gtan du ba'i grogs dang*/ ched du bya ba gzhan don 'dod pa rgyur bshad pa'i sgo nas bstan to/ /mdo las/ byang chub sems dpas ci nas bdag bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba dang*/ gzhan gyi don sgrub par bya'o/ /zhes de ltar don du gnyer bar byed pa yin no zhes so/ /'dir sems bskyed kyi mtha' dpyad pa la gnyis/ sems bskyed kyi rten dang*/ rang bzhin no/ /dang po la gnyis/ lus rten dang*/ sems rten no/ /dang po ni/ mdo las| de tshe lha mi stong phrag brgya/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /zhes pa dang*| lam shes kyi mdor/

lha'i bu rnams kyi sems bskyed par gsungs pa dang*| klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ klu nyi khri chig stong gis sems bskyed par gsungs pas theg chen la mos shing*/ sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa can gyi lha mi dang*/ klu la sogs pa dud 'gro ci rigs kyi rten la yang skye'o/ / bsam pa'i rten ni/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can te/ dze ta ris skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsungs pa ltar ro/ / gnyis pa la gsum/ rgyu ngo bo/ 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dad pa/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ byang sems kyi phan yon thos pa dang gsum ste/ dkon mchog sgron ma las/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad gyur cing*/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod la dad byed pa/ /byang chub bla na med la dad gyur na/ /skyes bu chen po rnams kyi sems skye'o/ /zhes dang*/ rgyan las| de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la bzhi| dngos dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ bskyed pa'i cho ga dang*/ bslab bya la slob tshul lo| |dang po ni/ nyi khri snang ba las/ sems bskyed pa zhes bya ba la sems ni rnam par shes （31na）pa ste rnam par rig pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa gang zhe na/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ste/ dkar po'i chos thams cad la dmigs pa ni de la srid pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'phags seng gnyis kyis gtso bo sems su bzhed do/ /de yang sems bskyed pa ni zhes gsungs pas sems byung bskyed pa la sems bskyed pa'i sgra'i don med pa la dgongs so/ /thogs med sku mched gnyis kyis sems byung du bzhed de/ byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam gyi mchog ni sems bskyed pa'o/ /zhes gzhan don du rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi smon lam du gsungs pa dang*/ rgyan 'grel las/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen ni yon tan gsum dang gnyis la dmigs pa dang ldan pa'i sems pa ni sems bskyed pa zhes bya'o/
